text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, ouch...!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: A-Are you alright, Laurel-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Don't worry, it's just a migraine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If I get some proper rest, I'm sure it'll 
get better right away. Plus, you two came 
to visit me, too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That will not do! A headache severe enough 
to keep you in bed...! I shall take 
thorough care of you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Me too! Sky-san is away right now, so... 
we'll nurse you in her place until you're 
completely recovered!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting...! I bought some 
cold black tea at full speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Caffeine is supposedly good for 
migraines... Since Laurel-san brought some 
for us back in the day as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If you would like seconds, just let me 
know anytime! I shall dash off to buy more 
immediately!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Please get plenty of sleep after that, 
okay? I'll replace the wet towel 
frequently.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I clearly remember when Laurel-san took 
care of us. You thoroughly cool down the 
painful spots, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll stay right by your side the whole 
time. If there's anything you want, please 
just let me know.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you two... you're worrying way too 
much. I'll be fine, so calm down, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, we want you to get well as soon 
as possible! Is there anything else we can 
do...?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...That's right. Whether it's nursing or 
running errands, we can do anything.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
We're no longer the helpless kids who 
could only stand by and watch...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Baku-chan, Chiyo-chan—

text_block_list.name: Young Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Laurel-san, you're observing today too... 
Do your legs hurt after all...?

text_block_list.name: Young Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, don't worry about it. You two do 
your best in training, okay!

text_block_list.name: Young Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No! I will stay right by Laurel-san's 
side! So you won't feel lonely!

text_block_list.name: Young Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Me too! Laurel-san, I'll make the pain go 
'pain, pain, fly away!' for you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(...That's right. Both of you were so 
worried and stayed by my side the entire 
time...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, maybe I'll indulge in a 
little selfishness.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
There's something I'd love to eat. The 
dish everyone from Victory Club made 
together... 'Sakura Zosui'!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
We all made it together so we wouldn't 
forget our unyielding spirit, even through 
cold winters.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So, I feel like eating 'Sakura Zosui' will 
fill me with the determination not to 
lose...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, how nostalgic...! Leave it to us! We 
shall whip up the finest 'Sakura Zosui' 
without fail!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll gather the ingredients right 
away! Laurel-san, please wait just a 
little while!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...This faintly sweet, cherry-blossom pink 
turnip. Along with such a gentle aroma and 
taste—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yup, it's just like the 'Sakura Zosui' 
from back then! It warms me right up to my 
core.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
O... Ohhhh! We did it!! It is a dish full 
of memories, after all! Naturally we made 
it delicious!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, so nostalgic. Strength is welling up 
inside me... feels like I'll be back on my 
feet in no time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad...! If you ever want to eat it 
again, please call us! We'll make it 
anytime!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, thank you. Hey, Baku-chan, 
Chiyo-chan—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'll be counting on you both from now on, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—So that happened, and they ended up 
pampering me quite a lot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Sakura Laurel carefully stretching 
out her body, I called out to her. She 
told me about what happened while she was 
taking time off.
choice_data_list: So, is your headache all gone now?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes! So today is training time. Together 
with Baku-chan and Chiyo-chan, the three 
of us!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I want to show those two my energetic 
running as soon as possible, after all♪
